visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with brown hair and glasses in a grey t-shirt stands before a black claw machine, holding a blue plush bag. He gestures toward the machine's glass in a bright, modern lobby with a pond visible outside. (2) Close-up on the machine interior filled with white and translucent plastic balls, labeled "Fish Feed." A young boy in a white t-shirt operates the joystick and buttons. (3) The boy unsuccessfully attempts to grab a ball, looking focused and then disappointed as the man watches and talks to him. (4) The man inserts a coin/token and the boy tries again; the man claps as the boy finally successfully retrieves a ball from the prize chute. (5) A young girl in a black shirt joins them, looking at the machine and the prize crate. (6) The man holds a tablet showing a restaurant menu with various meat dishes, specifically pointing to a pork rib item.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: TAN ZUO MA LI. [Subtitle]: 碳佐麻里現在也用娃娃機在騙錢了嗎. [Variety]: 碳佐麻里. (2) [Slogan]: Fish Feed 錦鯉寶玉. [Subtitle]: 今天來夾一台特別的娃娃機叫做錦鯉寶玉. (3) [Subtitle]: 夾空氣喔. 你再夾空氣喔. 我們投多少了. 四次了. 這個魚飼料太貴了吧. 你看 5 次了. 好扯 5 次了. 夾不到魚飼料. (4) [Subtitle]: 有了有了. 哇. 它不是保夾欸. 我看你自己帶飼料來比較快. (5) [Subtitle]: 妳剛才從 0 開始投嗎. 沒有它 90. 喔從 90 喔. 我們決定把它投保. (6) [Subtitle]: 好啦碳佐麻里給你賺好不好. 給你賺. 來給我 50 塊. 這裡這裡. 換一個排骨. 真的. 真的. (7) [Subtitle]: 直接給他 40 塊跟我保夾了. 叫他給我排骨好不好. 嘿. 排骨欸. 保夾了排骨. 為什麼夾排骨. 為什麼要夾排骨. 因為排骨比較值錢. (8) [Subtitle]: 你可以拿排骨餵魚啊. 我們剛夾的是這個.

(4) Distinct metallic 'clink' sound of a coin or token being dropped into a slot. BGM remains consistent in tempo and volume. (5) Cheerful, high-volume vocal reactions and a loud hand-clapping sound mark the success of the claw machine. (6) A second, younger child's voice asks a question with a prominent rising intonation. The track ends with the man explaining something in a warm, narrative tone.
